legends: System - Processes executing in kernel mode
User - Normal processes executing in user mode
Nice - Niced processes executing in user mode

Steal - Time spent in other operating systems when running in a virtualized environment

kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS system_lhs = SUM(CASE((labels.mode == "system"), IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total), NULL)), system_rhs = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.cpu), user_lhs = SUM(CASE((labels.mode == "user"), IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total), NULL)), user_rhs = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.cpu), nice_lhs = SUM(CASE((labels.mode == "nice"), IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total), NULL)), nice_rhs = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.cpu), iowait_lhs = SUM(CASE((labels.mode == "iowait"), IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total), NULL)), iowait_rhs = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.cpu), irq_lhs = SUM(CASE((labels.mode == "irq"), IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total), NULL)), irq_rhs = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.cpu), softirq_lhs = SUM(CASE((labels.mode == "softirq"), IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total), NULL)), softirq_rhs = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.cpu), steal_lhs = SUM(CASE((labels.mode == "steal"), IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total), NULL)), steal_rhs = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.cpu), idle_lhs = SUM(CASE((labels.mode == "idle"), IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total), NULL)), idle_rhs = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.cpu) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL System = (system_lhs / system_rhs), User = (user_lhs / user_rhs), Nice = (nice_lhs / nice_rhs), Iowait = (iowait_lhs / iowait_rhs), Irq = (irq_lhs / irq_rhs), Softirq = (softirq_lhs / softirq_rhs), Steal = (steal_lhs / steal_rhs), Idle = (idle_lhs / idle_rhs)
| EVAL __labels_ab = MV_APPEND("System - Processes executing in kernel mode", "User - Normal processes executing in user mode"), __labels_cd = MV_APPEND("Nice - Niced processes executing in user mode", "Iowait - Waiting for I/O to complete")
| EVAL __labels_ef = MV_APPEND("Irq - Servicing interrupts", "Softirq - Servicing softirqs"), __labels_gh = MV_APPEND("Steal - Time spent in other operating systems when running in a virtualized environment", "Idle - Waiting for something to happen")
| EVAL __labels = MV_APPEND(MV_APPEND(__labels_ab, __labels_cd), MV_APPEND(__labels_ef, __labels_gh))
| EVAL __values_ab = MV_APPEND(COALESCE(TO_STRING(System), ""), COALESCE(TO_STRING(User), "")), __values_cd = MV_APPEND(COALESCE(TO_STRING(Nice), ""), COALESCE(TO_STRING(Iowait), ""))
| EVAL __values_ef = MV_APPEND(COALESCE(TO_STRING(Irq), ""), COALESCE(TO_STRING(Softirq), "")), __values_gh = MV_APPEND(COALESCE(TO_STRING(Steal), ""), COALESCE(TO_STRING(Idle), ""))
| EVAL __values = MV_APPEND(MV_APPEND(__values_ab, __values_cd), MV_APPEND(__values_ef, __values_gh))
| EVAL __pairs = MV_ZIP(__labels, __values, "~")
| MV_EXPAND __pairs
| EVAL series_group = MV_FIRST(SPLIT(__pairs, "~")), value = TO_DOUBLE(MV_LAST(SPLIT(__pairs, "~")))
| KEEP time_bucket, series_group, value
| SORT time_bucket ASC
